The plate is about 26 cm across, so each sushi piece is roughly 3 cm wide and 2.5 cm tall, which puts it near 20 g.

- **Cucumber maki:** 2 pieces at about 18 g each, so 36 g.
- **Crab (kani) roll:** 2 pieces at about 25 g each, so 50 g.
- **Spicy crab/tobiko roll:** 2 pieces at about 30 g each, so 60 g. These are the orange-topped pieces.
- **Fried tofu:** 4 pieces at about 5×2.5×1.5 cm, roughly 18 g each, so 70 g.
